concept: an ancient treant whose heartwood remembers every fire and crushes what carries a torch
a vampire lord who rules a mountain court and commands the bats and wolves of the pass
a storm titan who walks the thunderhead and hurls lightning at the drowned
an archlich enthroned in a library of screaming books who binds the living with words
an ancient blue dragon that rules a glass desert and buries caravans in lightning-fused sand
a kraken of the black trench that drags warships under and crushes their hulls
a demon prince of locusts crowned in his own swarm who strips kingdoms to bone
a world-eating wyrm the size of a mountain that swallows cities and shrugs off armies
a death knight who leads a cavalry of the damned and burns the living with hellfire
a pit fiend general who commands legions of devils from a throne of iron
an empyrean child of the gods who walks the mortal world in judgment
an elder brain the size of a lake that dominates every mind for a hundred miles
